summary: SFL Corporation Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on September 11, 2026, disclosing an agreed charter extension with Hapag-Lloyd AG for six 15,400 TEU container vessels, extending coverage by seven additional years to 2035-2036 at firm rates. The new time charters add approximately $750 million to SFL's fixed-rate backlog, raising total backlog to roughly $4.6 billion. No board recommendation, advisor, price per share, or ownership change is involved. This is an ordinary commercial contract event rather than a special situation, with the risk-arb angle limited to counterparty credit and charter-rate durability.
